scripts.setup:python: bun run build:shared && bun electron/scripts/setup-uv.ts && bun electron/scripts/setup-python.ts
scripts.dev: bun run build:shared && concurrently -k -n "frontend,electron" -c "blue,green" "(cd frontend && bun dev)" "(cd electron && bun dev)"
scripts.build: bun run build:shared && bun run build:frontend && bun run build:backend && bun run build:electron
scripts.lint:python: bun electron/scripts/ruff.ts check electron/python electron/tests/build123d && bun run --bun pyright --project pyrightconfig.json
scripts.lint:python:fix: bun electron/scripts/ruff.ts check --fix electron/python electron/tests/build123d && bun run --bun pyright --project pyrightconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:shared && bun run typecheck:backend && bun run typecheck:frontend && bun run typecheck:electron
scripts.package: bun run build && (cd electron && bun run package)
